errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the FT (green) line declines to 16.4 at ratio 0.5 and 16.2 at ratio 0.7. In the figure, the FT line is flat at a value of approximately 16.85 from ratio 0.2 to 0.7.
The description states the LoRA 64 (purple) line is near 17.2 at ratio 0.5. The figure shows this point is visibly lower, at approximately 17.1.

The description states the LoRA 64 (purple) line is at 16.95 at ratio 0.9. However, the LoRA 64 line is below the LoRA 16 (red) line at this point. The description gives a value of 16.92 for the red line, so the purple line's value must be lower than 16.92, not higher.
